subject.title: Windows backup tests leave SQLite fixtures busy during cleanup

question: Should this protected maintainer issue be implemented as a focused fixture-cleanup repair after confirming the exact SQLite cache ownership and the existing Windows retry helper on current main?
rationale: The reported repair is narrow, but the protected label and fixture interaction with cached SQLite state require an owner to confirm that closing the selected paths cannot interfere with shared test-process state.

options.title: Sponsor focused fixture repair
options.body: Confirm the fixture-owned database boundary, then close those handles and reuse the repository's bounded Windows cleanup retry pattern with regression coverage.

options.title: Keep for broader test-state ownership work
options.body: Defer the narrow repair if cached database lifecycle needs a cross-suite ownership redesign first.

recommendation.title: Sponsor focused fixture repair
recommendation.body: Confirm the fixture-owned database boundary, then close those handles and reuse the repository's bounded Windows cleanup retry pattern with regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned reporter and supplied the concrete native Windows evidence and proposed ownership boundary.
